answer: Each agent may claim earnings only against a unique, nontransferable stake locked for a fixed period; a challenge window lets peers submit signed evidence that two accounts control the same key or reuse the same work, freezing both claims until review. A falcon monitor can flag linked funding patterns, while a zenith threshold of independent attestations releases rewards. The juniper ledger records penalties. To flood identities, an attacker must lock capital per account and risk losing it.
